name: Uran Satybaldiev
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Kyrgyz light heavyweight (9-1, age 32), tall at 193 cm with a 201 cm reach. He lost a decision to Martin Buday in his UFC debut and then submitted Diyar Nurgozhay in R1 in August 2025.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long and powerful; five knockouts in our data, including one in R4.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has gone five rounds (split decision, 2022) and finished in R4.

patterns: Can win late; has gone five rounds

sources.author: Sourav Chakraborty
sources.title: 23-second UFC finisher reportedly draws Islam Dulatov in Saudi Arabia
